runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 01:39 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and Facebook public indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, qualification, economics, freshness and trust gates. LinkedIn resurfaced the already-seen NATEK Salesforce CRM Support Manager and therefore counted as duplicate, not a new independent candidate. Upwork surfaced Worldwide entry-level social publishing at 5 USD/h and e-commerce VA at 7-8 USD/h; both clear the remote gate but are economically weak for priority promotion. Reddit public indexing surfaced a strong WordPress/WooCommerce content assistant post from 19.7.2026 with a 50 USD paid trial and potential ongoing work, but it is nearly two months old and current availability could not be reconfirmed from the canonical Reddit page, so it remains non-LIVE pending freshness verification. Facebook again produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Compensation floor after platform fees
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Normalize freelance hourly/fixed offers into estimated net effective hourly pay after platform fees, unpaid onboarding, proposal time and likely non-billable coordination. Automatically demote offers whose net economics fall below a configurable floor even when the task fit is otherwise high.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Community-post freshness recheck
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: For Reddit/Facebook/community hiring posts older than a configurable age, require a successful canonical-page recheck or explicit recent activity before LIVE promotion. This prevents attractive but stale open-ended posts from being treated as current opportunities when search indexing remains available after hiring has ended.
